title: Unit 408 master bedroom: set S/T/U
overview: Three complete, fully sourced master-bedroom schemes for Unit 408: S Wengue Teal (dark wengue bed in an ivory room, one teal accent, chrome and white light), T Birch Coral (pale birch, one coral accent, glazed ceramic lamps) and U Whitewash Emerald (whitewashed pine, one emerald accent, clear glass light). Every piece is a published retail product; prices are frozen catalogue or dated page reads; unknown prices are QUOTE REQUIRED.
requirements: MANDATORY: finished 50 mm mattress, 72 × 78 inches (1828.8 × 1981.2 mm), on continuous flat support with no exposed slats or gaps. No thick mattress, topper or box spring.
All prices assume new purchases. Three distinct sets of visible furniture, bedside lamps, fixtures, mirrors, rugs, textiles, plants and decor. Matching bedside pairs within each design.
Closed practical bedside storage, armrests on every chair, compact console with sourced decor. No extra generic styling objects.
75-inch wall TV baseline; 65-inch minimum, 85-inch optional pending price and clearance checks. 65-inch reference saves ₱12,000 in merchandise before contingency.
Split AC at the window-side corner of the TV wall, with airflow directed away from sleepers. Installer must verify location and capacity.
Mirror on the wall return between the two perpendicular doors. Preserve native irregular geometry, both doors, closet and warm narrow-block parquet.
Common technical essentials are owner-approved. Existing Davies Beige blackout/voile treatment and concealed old window AC remain a fixed room requirement.
procurement_gates: No scheme is purchase-ready until the bed supplier accepts the exact 50 mm mattress on a continuous flat deck. Fino (S) support is unpublished; BJÖRKSNÄS (T) and HEMNES (U) ship with Luröy slats and are 180×200 cm frames against the 1828.8 mm mattress (SIZE FLAG). King outer sizes are unpublished for all three beds (plans use assumed outers).

Prices are frozen catalogue references (live-Airtable snapshot 20 Oct 2026) with each line's own price date; beds were read from supplier JSON or the IKEA PH search API on 21 Oct 2026. Product existence and photos are verified; exact Cebu stock, address delivery and checkout totals are not.

Colour, variant and size gates: Bamboo Luxury duvet cover Ivory is a Queen listing (King to confirm); Family Home Hotel Living sheets are rendered peach as photographed but listed White, Mocha, Sand and Gray (priced on White / Queen; colour and King SKU to confirm); Canadian T300 Fossil Gray King SKU and price to confirm; Amanda TV cabinet finish as photographed (pale grey-oak; the listing says Cherry) to confirm; HAY Arbour Club price and fabric to quote; Taylow lamp dimensions unpublished; Nat13 (450×400×500) and Porro Neve (570×530×780) dimensions are plan assumptions; every duvet cover and insert in King.
TV mount is the True Vision TV73-69F; installer to confirm substrate, anchors and Samsung fixings.
Curtain ₱42,420 is the carried 16 October quote reference: ₱36,720 master treatment plus ₱3,800 valance and ₱1,900 sticks allocations. Remeasurement quote required.
Trade/freight/mattress/deck reserves total ₱35,000–84,000 as estimator allowances, not supplier quotations. 10 % contingency added, totals rounded up to the next ₱1,000.

schemes.title: Wengue Teal
schemes.rationale: The dark wengue Fino bed with its black floating headboard carries the room; everything else is pale so it reads. Teal is the one colour: a teal sunburst cushion on an ivory bamboo duvet, a faceted teal glass vase on the console and the blue-teal abstract over the bed. White MALM drawers, a white-gloss BYÅS console and a cream ISMANTORP armchair with bentwood-style arms keep the floor light; satin-nickel Larcy lamps and a chrome-framed mirror give the cool metal. Ivory GEOLOG rug, grey bamboo sheets and a pencil succulent in a white bowl. Squint phrase: dark bed, ivory, teal.
fit_notes: MALM 400×480 bedsides each side of the Fino King; Fino King outer size unpublished, fit uses an assumed outer.
BYÅS 1600 mm console is at the ≤1600 mm short-wall limit.
GEOLOG 160×230 rug under the lower two-thirds of the bed.

schemes.title: Birch Coral
schemes.rationale: Pale birch and oak throughout: the spindle-headboard BJÖRKSNÄS bed, Astrid two-drawer bedsides, an Amanda light-oak console and a maple-framed Jea mirror. Coral is the one accent, in a terracotta linen lumbar cushion and the coral half-circle prints over the bed, with the pink JÄRNVÄG rug as its quiet echo. Off-white BLIDVÄDER stoneware lamps, a natural faux-linen comforter, sand sheets and an oak HAY Arbour chair in rose. An olive stem in a whitewashed terracotta vase. Squint phrase: pale birch, coral, ceramic.
fit_notes: Astrid 550×420 bedsides are the widest in the set; check the clearance to the window wall.
Amanda 1500 mm console fits the ≤1600 mm short wall.
BJÖRKSNÄS is a 180×200 frame: SIZE FLAG against the 1828.8 mm mattress.

schemes.title: Whitewash Emerald
schemes.rationale: A whitewashed HEMNES pine bed against black: black faux-leather two-drawer night tables, a JÄTTESTA console, a Porro Neve black ash armchair and a ribbed black arch mirror. Emerald is the accent, in a green Santiago cushion, a fern-green marble tray and the green palm canvas over the bed. Smoked glass gives the light: the Taylow faceted lamps. White quilted coverlet, grey Tencel sheets, a black-and-natural striped Rouen jute rug and a peperomia in a black pot. Squint phrase: whitewash, black, emerald.
fit_notes: Furniture Manila 002 night tables are 406×406 mm; lamps sit centred.
JÄTTESTA 1600 mm console is at the ≤1600 mm short-wall limit.
Rouen 183×274 rug is the largest in the set; check the door swing and wardrobe clearance.
